negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, watermark, text
decision_rules: Unit: 16 scene/seed pairs. Primary evidence: the user's blind review sheets; OWLv2/CLIP are secondary only.
Structure failure = count, colour or shape marked fail for an image.

Region merge (direct_scribble_region) replaces direct_scribble for stage 2 only if it is chosen as most natural with correct structure in at least 3 more pairs than direct_scribble, and has at most 1 more structure failure across the 16 pairs.

The scribble arm kept by the rule above goes to stage 2 instead of direct_box only if it has no more structure failures than direct_box and is chosen in at least 3 more pairs than direct_box; otherwise stage 2 uses direct_box.
If every arm has a structure failure in more than 4 of the 16 pairs, stop the direct line and report it as negative.
No tuning, reranking, extra seeds or reruns on these scenes to change the outcome; failed images stay in the record.
locked_note: Locked before any output for these scenes. Bird placement box was moved once after viewing the rendered sketches (no generated images) so the overlap scene actually overlaps.
